All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.

people.name: Eshcol_Valley
people.line: Valley where Israelite spies obtained a large cluster of grapes

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Yahweh had given them.
translations.bsb: For when your fathers went up to the Valley of Eshcol and saw the land, they discouraged the Israelites from entering the land that the LORD had given them.
translations.kjv: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given
translations.asv: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Jehovah had given them.
